_doc: Owner-curated next-tool recommendations. Each entry says: when the named tool finishes with the given signal pattern, recommend the listed tool. The first matching entry wins; if no entry matches, the recommender returns null (the calling tool shows no card). Editing rule: keep this file small. If you find yourself adding more than ~3 entries per source tool, the source tool is probably too generic and should emit narrower signals. Locale strings are EN; the recommender helper localizes via the ES tool URL. Schema validated by scripts/check-next-tool-map.mjs (TODO: write).

rules.label_en: Most failed audits start with menu pricing. Plate Cost is the calculator the audit recommends.
rules.label_es: La mayoría de los diagnósticos bajos empiezan con los precios del menú. Costo del Plato es la calculadora que el diagnóstico recomienda.
